youtube.title: What is the flattest country in the world? Its peak is 5 metres high 📏
youtube.description:
Netherlands, Denmark or the third one? One nation's highest natural point would fit under a two-storey house, and most of its land sits about a metre and a half above the sea. Its capital is ringed by a wall, and its government once held a cabinet meeting underwater to make the point.
Guess before the map lights up, then see the three high points side by side and the wall that keeps the capital dry.
Which did you pick?
